description: Get the current active pricing for all models in a normalised, machine-readable format optimised for routing logic. Returns one row per active tier price. Rows with headline: false are real but non-list rates (Batch, Flex, off-peak, and prompt-cache reads/writes, whose units are per_1m_tokens_cache_read / per_1m_tokens_cache_write); filter on headline: true before taking the cheapest row per unit. Token units (per_1m_tokens_*) are shared across modalities, so also filter on modality; token_modality says which medium a token rate applies to. Treat an unknown unit as not comparable.

provider.description: Optional provider slug to filter the feed. A canonical company id (e.g. 'google', 'openai', 'together') expands to that company's offerings across every vertical it spans.

name: modelglass_get_pricing_feed

changes_on.description: Set when a better change (price drop, launch) is held back a day: the provider's date. The new price shows from the next UTC day.

from_provider_date.description: Set when a worse change (price rise, promo end) is shown a day early: the provider's date it starts.

modality.description: The offering's modality (text-generation, text-to-image, text-to-video, …). Token units are shared across modalities, so filter on this as well as unit.

shuts_down_on.description: Set on this tier's last listed day: the provider's shutdown date. It may already be unavailable.

token_modality.description: On a token-unit tier that records it: the medium the rate applies to. Absent otherwise.
